tuning.defeatLine: The road is still there. So are we. Again.

keeperPowers.name: Lantern Flare
keeperPowers.desc: Reveals fog and deals 180 fixed harm in a tapped 3×3 area (45s cooldown).

keeperPowers.name: Time Lull
keeperPowers.desc: Slows all enemies on the field to 50% speed for 5s (60s cooldown).

keeperPowers.name: Mote Rain
keeperPowers.desc: Calls 6 drifting Lumen motes (150 Lumen total) down from the sky at once (75s cooldown).

synergies.title: Multiplicative Chill & Slows
synergies.text: Slows from Frostflare, Mirewort, Chronolamp, and Time Lull stack multiplicatively down to a 30% base speed floor.

synergies.title: Additive Warden Aura Buffs
synergies.text: Lanternkeeper (+25% harm, +1 range) and Keeper's Standard (+20% attack speed) stack additively up to a +50% cap.

synergies.title: Root + Area Splash Combo
synergies.text: Rift Snare, Gloomroot, and Thornwall hold walkers inside Mirewort poison zones and Dawnbreaker / Skyflare splash arcs.

synergies.title: Anti-Air Canopy Defense
synergies.text: Flying Gloomkin (Duskwing) bypass ground traps and standard lane bolts; they can ONLY be harmed by Skyflare, Skywarden, Farshot, and elevated Tower-Plot defenders (Ember Sentry), plus area tactics.

defenders.name: Sparkshot
defenders.flavor: A three-legged brass lantern fitted with a ground crystal lens. Standard issue for every Warden on the Green.
defenders.bramLine: Polished the lens twice and tightened the brass collar. It'll punch clean through the dark.

defenders.name: Lumen Well
defenders.flavor: A carved stone basin lined with sky-crystal that draws drifting Daystar light into usable Lumen.
defenders.bramLine: Deeper facets in the basin catch more of the sky's drift. Keep a row of these humming.

defenders.name: Bulwark
defenders.flavor: A heavy dark-iron lantern post forged from Kindlekeep's old gate plates. Holds the lane while shooters work.
defenders.bramLine: Double-riveted iron and a thicker post. Let them chew on that for a while.

defenders.name: Frostflare
defenders.flavor: An ice-crystal spire brought down from Frostmere, set in a warm brass cradle. Its bolts chill shadow solid.
defenders.bramLine: Careful with the tongs. A colder core means a slower march down our road.

defenders.name: Twinflare
defenders.flavor: Two brass lamp housings balanced on a single swivel post. Twice the bolts for lanes under heavy pressure.
defenders.bramLine: Two chambers, one post, zero hesitation. It argues twice as loud.

defenders.name: Rift Snare
defenders.flavor: A flat stone disc carved with Warden binding runes. Roots the first ground walker that steps across its ring.
defenders.bramLine: Chiseled the rune-grooves deeper. Once it grabs hold, they aren't going anywhere fast.

defenders.name: Glowmine
defenders.flavor: A buried brass charge packed with compressed Lumen. Takes twelve seconds to arm, then clears a crowd on contact.
defenders.bramLine: Finer fuse-powder means it arms quicker and kicks like a mule.

defenders.name: Flashcharge
defenders.flavor: An emergency Warden flare-vessel. Unleashes an instant 3x3 burst of golden light that shatters armor and crowds.
defenders.bramLine: Coiled the filament tighter. Stand well back when you drop this one.

defenders.name: Skyflare
defenders.flavor: A swivel-mounted mortar lantern that lobs arcing shells over obstacles into the thickest cluster.
defenders.bramLine: Calibrated the elevation arc. Nothing hides behind a shield from above.

defenders.name: Chainwisp
defenders.flavor: A storm-wisp housed in a copper lattice. Releases arcs that leap across three nearby Gloomkin.
defenders.bramLine: Copper coils tuned to perfection. Watch it jump from shadow to shadow.

defenders.name: Galeward
defenders.flavor: A wind-chime spire that sends a compressed gust down the lane, pushing advancing walkers back.
defenders.bramLine: Tuned the chimes a third higher. That breeze has real shoulders now.

defenders.name: Stone Warden
defenders.flavor: A carved granite sentinel with lantern eyes. Holds the front and strikes any ground foe in reach.
defenders.bramLine: Good quarry stone never forgets its shape. Hit hard, stand firmer.

defenders.name: Menderlight
defenders.flavor: A warm green-gold halo lamp that knits cracked brass and restores adjacent guardians.
defenders.bramLine: Steady warmth keeps iron from cracking in the cold.

defenders.name: Farshot
defenders.flavor: A long-barreled tripod lantern rifle that singles out the strongest threat in its lane.
defenders.bramLine: Long barrel, ground sight-glass. Aim for the biggest shadow on the road.

defenders.name: Chronolamp
defenders.flavor: An intricate clockwork escapement lamp whose turning rings thicken time for nearby Gloomkin.
defenders.bramLine: Escapement gears oiled and balanced. Time walks on our side now.

upgrades.desc: 50% slow + allies in aura attack 15% faster

defenders.name: Dawncaller
defenders.flavor: A tall radiant obelisk crowned with a fragment of the Great Lantern. Projects a continuous beam down the lane.
defenders.bramLine: Pure kept light. Nothing stands in front of a Dawncaller for long.

defenders.name: Thornwall
defenders.flavor: A dark-iron barricade woven with white-hot lantern filaments that sear any Gloomkin biting it.
defenders.bramLine: Barbed the iron ribs and wired them straight to the core. Let them take a bite now.

defenders.name: Tidecaller
defenders.flavor: A resonant marsh-bell that sends a sweeping wave of light down its entire lane, pushing all ground foes back one cell.
defenders.bramLine: Cast the bell in heavy bronze. When it rings, the whole lane takes a step back.

defenders.name: Starfall
defenders.flavor: An astrolabe lens that calls down a concentrated shower of Daystar shards across a tapped 3×3 zone.
defenders.bramLine: Aligned the mirrors to the upper sky. Point it at a crowd and watch the shards fall.

defenders.name: Lanternkeeper
defenders.flavor: A warm brazier-pillar that feeds adjacent guardians, granting +1 cell range and +25% harm (stacks additively up to +50%).
defenders.bramLine: Purest oil in the valley. Set your best shooters beside it and watch them shine.

defenders.name: Mirewort
defenders.flavor: An alchemical marsh-censer that seeps luminous mire across a 3×3 zone, dealing continuous harm and slowing walkers.
defenders.bramLine: Distilled marsh-vapor and luminous salt. Everything crossing that mist drags its feet.

defenders.name: Skywarden
defenders.flavor: A high-angle twin ballista that ONLY targets flying Gloomkin across the field, dealing massive anti-air harm.
defenders.bramLine: Counterweighted for sky-angles only. If it has wings, it doesn't cross our road.

defenders.name: Gloomroot
defenders.flavor: An amber-forged clamp set into the cobbles that roots the first enemy on its cell for 4s and rapidly resets.
defenders.bramLine: Coiled spring-steel beneath the runes. Snaps shut, holds tight, resets before the next wave.

defenders.name: Dawnbreaker
defenders.flavor: A heavy siege howitzer that lobs massive shells of compressed dawn over obstacles, shattering whole clusters.
defenders.bramLine: Thickest barrel I ever poured. One shell clears an entire crossroads.

defenders.name: Ember Sentry
defenders.flavor: An elevated watch-brazier placed exclusively on high stone Tower Plots along the road's rim. Fires across lanes and hits flyers.
defenders.bramLine: Set it on the high stone ledges above the road. It sees over every lane and swats wings out of the sky.

defenders.name: Gleamharvest
defenders.flavor: A delicate prismatic condenser that generates Lumen over time and accelerates adjacent Lumen Wells by 35%. Fragile—keep it protected.
defenders.bramLine: Spun glass and fine silver wire. Keep it behind a wall and you'll swim in Lumen.

defenders.name: Mirrorwarden
defenders.flavor: A silvered concave aegis that reflects enemy ranged globs and bolts straight back at the spitter for 150% harm.
defenders.bramLine: Silvered crystal plate polished to a mirror finish. Let the spitters taste their own medicine.

defenders.name: Keeper's Standard
defenders.flavor: The heraldic standard of the Lantern Wardens. Slowly mends adjacent guardians (18 HP/s) and boosts their attack speed by 20%. Fragile, high value.
defenders.bramLine: Woven with gold-thread from the Great Lantern's hall. Guard the banner and the line holds.

enemies.name: Murkling
enemies.flavor: A shambling heap of road-shadow with twin ember eyes, drawn inexorably toward warm lantern light.
enemies.counter: Any shooter (Sparkshot, Twinflare).

enemies.name: Swiftshade
enemies.flavor: A lean streak of living dusk that skims low across the stones, trading bulk for unsettling speed.
enemies.counter: Frostflare chill bolts and Rift Snares.

enemies.name: Gloombrute
enemies.flavor: A towering mass of compressed night whose heavy tread rattles the cobbles of Kindlekeep Green.
enemies.counter: Focus fire, Bulwark stalls, and Glowmines.

enemies.name: Shadehound
enemies.flavor: A four-legged shadow courser that crouches and lunges forward in sudden bursts down the road.
enemies.counter: Rift Snares, Glowmines, and Frostflare slows.

enemies.name: Rustplate
enemies.flavor: A Gloomkin clad in scavenged iron plates. Standard light bolts glance off its rust-thickened shell.
enemies.counter: Blasts and AoE (Glowmine, Flashcharge, Skyflare) deal full harm to armor.

enemies.name: Duskwing
enemies.flavor: A winged shadow that glides high above ground snares and mines, diving only to strike a guardian.
enemies.counter: Only Skyflare, Skywarden, Farshot, Ember Sentry (Tower Plot), and area tactics (Flashcharge, Starfall) can harm it.

enemies.name: Gloomwarden
enemies.flavor: Carries a condensed dusk-plate that absorbs frontal bolts before its core can be harmed.
enemies.counter: Lobbed shells (Skyflare), ground traps (Rift Snare, Glowmine), and Flashcharge bursts.

enemies.name: Dirtskulker
enemies.flavor: Slips beneath the marsh sod to advance unseen, surfacing only when it reaches a guardian.
enemies.counter: Time burst harm and blockers for when it surfaces.

enemies.name: Gloomspitter
enemies.flavor: Halts three cells out to hurl corrosive globs of ash-shadow at the front line.
enemies.counter: Farshot rifles and fast burst tactics.

enemies.name: Splitling
enemies.flavor: An unstable knot of shadow that cleaves into two hungry Motes the moment its shell breaks.
enemies.counter: AoE blasts, Chainwisp arcs, and beams.

enemies.name: Gloomchanter
enemies.flavor: Hums a low, lightless cadence that mends nearby Gloomkin within two cells.
enemies.counter: Eliminate first with Farshot or Flashcharge.

enemies.name: Volatile Wisp
enemies.flavor: A swollen spark of unstable dusk that detonates violently when dissolved, harming nearby guardians.
enemies.counter: Dissolve at long range before it nears your front line.

enemies.name: Duskreaver
enemies.flavor: A blade-armed vanguard of the Gloomgate whose stride shrugs off half of any chill or slow.
enemies.counter: Concentrated fire, Stone Wardens, and Glowmines.

enemies.name: Gloomtitan
enemies.flavor: A colossus of ancient night, unmoved by gusts or snares, marching slowly toward the Great Lantern.
enemies.counter: Every guardian in the lane firing together.

enemies.name: Burrower
enemies.flavor: Dives beneath the roadbed to bypass frontline guardians, surfacing right behind them unless caught by a snare or mine.
enemies.counter: Rift Snares, Gloomroots, and Glowmines trigger on it underground and force it to surface.

enemies.name: Mirrorwraith
enemies.flavor: A crystalline dusk-specter that reflects 25% of direct bolt harm back onto the firing guardian.
enemies.counter: Glowmines, area effects (Skyflare, Mirewort, Dawnbreaker, Starfall), and Lastlight Wards.

enemies.name: Leechling
enemies.flavor: A hungry siphon-parasite that drains 10 stored Lumen from your reserves every time its teeth strike a guardian.
enemies.counter: Eliminate it at range with Twinflare, Frostflare, or snares before it reaches the line.

enemies.name: Frostbound
enemies.flavor: Carved from eternal rime-shadow, completely immune to all chill bolts and time-slowing auras.
enemies.counter: Raw concentrated harm (Twinflare, Farshot, Dawnbreaker, Glowmine).

enemies.name: Siphon
enemies.flavor: Carries a smothering censer whose dark aura causes nearby guardians within 2 cells to attack 30% slower.
enemies.counter: Focus it first with long-range Farshot rifles or Ember Sentries.

enemies.name: Swarmhost
enemies.flavor: A bulbous hive-shadow that sheds a fast Swarmlet down its lane every 6 seconds as it marches.
enemies.counter: Area harm and splash cannons (Skyflare, Mirewort, Dawnbreaker, Dawncaller).

enemies.name: Phasewalker
enemies.flavor: Steps through a dusk-seam every 5 seconds to blink forward 2 cells down the road.
enemies.counter: Rift Snares, Gloomroots, Thornwalls, and Glowmines placed on its landing cells.

enemies.name: Thornback
enemies.flavor: Bristles with jagged shadow-spines that inflict heavy recoil harm on any melee guardian striking it.
enemies.counter: Ranged bolts, artillery shells, and beams from a safe distance.

enemies.name: Gloomherald
enemies.flavor: Bears a dusk-horn banner whose cadence accelerates all nearby Gloomkin by 25%.
enemies.counter: Focus it first with Farshot, Starfall, or Flashcharge.

enemies.name: Laneswitcher
enemies.flavor: A six-legged skitterer that darts sideways into an adjacent lane at marked switch-points along the road.
enemies.counter: Balanced defenses across all five lanes and cross-lane Ember Sentries.

enemies.name: Gloomidol
enemies.flavor: A stationary obelisk of condensed night placed mid-field by the wave script; summons Gloomkin until shattered.
enemies.counter: Concentrated lane fire, Starfall strikes, and Dawnbreaker shells.

enemies.name: Dreadknight
enemies.flavor: An armored colossus immune to knockback and snares whose broad cleaver strikes two adjacent cells at once.
enemies.counter: Heavy focus harm combined with Frostflare and Chronolamp slows.

bosses.name: Murkmaw
bosses.flavor: A colossal Murkling crowned with shattered way-lantern brass. Its roar calls lesser shadows out of the ditch.
bosses.counter: Keep lane 3 fortified with Bulwarks, Twinflares, and Frostflare while saving Flashcharge for its summons.

bosses.name: Bogmother
bosses.flavor: An ancient marsh leviathan wreathed in river-fog that spawns Splitlings every 25 seconds.
bosses.counter: Place lanterns to pierce the marsh fog and use AoE splash against her Splitlings.

bosses.name: The Cinder Stag
bosses.flavor: Cinderwood's ancient guardian claimed by ash-shadow; charges 2 cells every 15s, trampling the frontline for 200 harm.
bosses.counter: Keep high-HP Thornwalls or Bulwarks in front to absorb its telegraphed charges.

bosses.name: The Rime Matron
bosses.flavor: A frozen Warden of old whose frost nova every 20 seconds slows all guardians in her lane by 50% for 4s.
bosses.counter: Cross-lane Ember Sentries and Keeper's Standards offset her frost nova.

bosses.name: Umbra, Herald of Dusk
bosses.flavor: The voice of the Gloom across three escalating phases: shielded vanguards, gloom tides, and a final dusk surge.
bosses.counter: Combine Dawncallers, Lanternkeepers, Ember Sentries, and well-timed Keeper Powers.

bosses.name: The Hollow Choir
bosses.flavor: A resonant chorus of dusk-echoes that summons Gloomchanters and Siphons while humming a dampening cadence.
bosses.counter: Snipe its summoned chanters immediately with Farshot and Starfall.

bosses.name: The Ashen King
bosses.flavor: An ancient monarch of the burnt pass whose telegraphed crown rotates between bolt-ward and splash-ward.
bosses.counter: Mix bolt shooters (Twinflare) with splash cannons (Dawnbreaker) and beams (Dawncaller).

bosses.name: The Maw Remnant
bosses.flavor: The final lingering echo of the Gloomgate's hunger—two relentless phases testing every Warden art.
bosses.counter: Full Tier 3 Workshop mastery, all Tower Plots occupied, and coordinated Keeper Powers.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The Daystar guttered, and the dark came down the old road.
You're the new Keeper the Great Lantern chose? You're young.

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: I'm here.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Good answer. The road is that way.
The dark is coming down it.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Guardians hold the lanes. Lumen feeds them. You spend it wisely.
The wards at the gate are your last line. Spend them never, if you can.

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: And if I can't?

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Then we relight, and try again. That's the job.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: OH! OH! A Keeper! A real one!

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: That's Pip. It follows the light around. It followed you.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: I'll help! I'll help lots! Watch me help!

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: The quiet ones are always the best ones!

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: That's Murkmaw. Biggest one we've seen.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: It's SO big. Why is it so big?!

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: It calls the little ones to it. Burn it down, and they scatter.

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: Light the road.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Light the road.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The Green is held. The road is open.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: We did SO much holding!

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The marsh road is next. Bram's crew is waiting, and the fog is thick.

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: Then we go.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: That's the spirit. Pack a dry coat.

beats.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
lines: Fog eats light. So we bring more light.
Six way-lanterns drowned along the causeway. Hold the line while my crew bolts the brass.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Mind the eastern mist, Keeper. Place guardians forward to part the fog.

beats.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
lines: Water's boiling by the sixth post. That's Bogmother.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: She spawns Splitlings out of the river-mist. Keep Skyflares and Chainwisps ready.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Bram, you've been a Warden for years. You just never signed the paper.

beats.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
lines: ...Fetch me a pen, then.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The forest burned a generation ago. Now it's regrowing under the ash.
The old Warden outpost is ahead—and its sleeping guardians with it.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: The little green shoots are SO brave!

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The Cinder Stag—the forest's old guardian, tangled in the Gloom.
Free it, Keeper. Brace for its charges and burn away the shadow.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The forest burned once. It grew back. Remember that when things look finished.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: It bowed to us! Did you see its antlers shine?!

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Frostmere in deep winter. The northern beacon-tower stands across the lake ice.
Watch columns four and five—the ice speeds their march.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: She held this tower alone for thirty years before the cold took her lamp.
Light it for her, Keeper.

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: For her.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: With her last warmth, she lit the beacon herself. The northern road is open.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: Look at the horizon—is that a rumor of dawn?!

beats.speaker: Umbra, Herald of Dusk
lines: You climb so tirelessly, little Keeper. Yet light is a heavy burden, and the dark is gentle rest.

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: We keep the lamps lit.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Polite as ever, Umbra. And wrong as ever. Climb on, Keeper.

beats.speaker: Umbra, Herald of Dusk
lines: Here is the seam where the Daystar's warmth flows into quiet rest. Lay down your lantern.

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: Never.

beats.speaker: Umbra, Herald of Dusk
lines: You pour the Great Lantern's kept light into the seam... You give it... freely?

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: It's not mine to keep. It's theirs.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The seam is sealed from the inside. Look up—the Daystar steadies!
The Gloom withdraws like an outgoing tide.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Well. That's the road held. Tea's on, Keeper. You earned it.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: BEST. DAWN. EVER.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: Do you hear that low humming in the ruins, {KEEPER}?

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The Hollow Choir—old echoes of the Dimming gathered in one voice. Silence the chanters first.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: Only birdsong in the ruins now!

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: A much better tune, if you ask me.

beats.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
lines: Look at the crown on that colossus. When it shifts amber, bolts bounce off; when it shifts violet, splash bounces off.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Then we bring both, Bram. Show him how Wardens fight.

beats.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
lines: Not a dent in our cannons. That's Kindlekeep craftsmanship.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: The very last knot of shadow left in the valley pass!

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: One last watch.

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Together, {KEEPER}. Light the whole road.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: Look! Even the highest pass is warm and golden now!

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Forty years I walked this highway in the dark. Today I walk it in the morning.

story.title: Epilogue I: Market Day in Kindlekeep

beats.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
lines: Wagons rolling in from Frostmere and the Marsh with their lamps still warm.
Never thought I'd forge hinges for open gates instead of barricades.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: And the bakery gave me a whole cinnamon bun! Well—I hovered over it!

story.title: Epilogue II: The New Wardens' Hall

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: Twelve new apprentices signed the ledger this morning, {KEEPER}.
They all asked who taught you to hold five lanes at once. I told them you just listened to the road.

story.title: Epilogue III: Under the Steady Daystar

beats.speaker: Warden Mira
lines: The Great Lantern hums so softly now you can sleep right through it.

beats.speaker: The Keeper
lines: The light holds.

beats.speaker: Pip
lines: Because we kept it! Forever and ever!

storyQuests.title: Pip's First Spark
storyQuests.speaker: Pip
storyQuests.dialogue: I started a collection of shiny road-pebbles! Help me clear our first watch on the Green!

storyQuests.title: Wells of the Green
storyQuests.speaker: Pip
storyQuests.dialogue: Lumen Wells hum the prettiest note when you set six of them down!

storyQuests.title: High Ledge Watch
storyQuests.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
storyQuests.dialogue: Try out my Ember Sentries on the elevated stone plots along the rim.

storyQuests.title: Taming Murkmaw
storyQuests.speaker: Pip
storyQuests.dialogue: We cleared the whole Green! Look, Bram made me a tiny brass crown!

storyQuests.title: Parting the Mist
storyQuests.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
storyQuests.dialogue: My crew can't bolt brass in the dark. Clear the first marsh causeway for us.

storyQuests.title: Tide and Thorn
storyQuests.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
storyQuests.dialogue: Set four Thornwalls along the mud-flats and watch the burrowers regret it.

storyQuests.title: Tempered in Glimmer
storyQuests.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
storyQuests.dialogue: Two Workshop upgrades forged. Good tools make a calm Warden.

storyQuests.title: The Sixth Way-Lantern
storyQuests.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
storyQuests.dialogue: Every way-lantern burning from here to Kindlekeep. Proud to sign the Warden book beside you.

storyQuests.title: The Old Outpost
storyQuests.speaker: Warden Mira
storyQuests.dialogue: Forty years ago I stood my first watch at this outpost. Let's dust off the braziers.

storyQuests.title: Brazier Synergy
storyQuests.speaker: Warden Mira
storyQuests.dialogue: Lanternkeepers were my mentor's favorite guardian. Their warmth steadies every shooter beside them.

storyQuests.title: The Winding Ravine
storyQuests.speaker: Warden Mira
storyQuests.dialogue: You held the winding ravine road even cleaner than my old squad did.

storyQuests.title: Mercy for the Stag
storyQuests.speaker: Warden Mira
storyQuests.dialogue: The Cinder Stag walks free among the green shoots. That is what Wardens are for.

storyQuests.title: Across the Rime
storyQuests.speaker: Warden Mira
storyQuests.dialogue: Farshot rifles and Menderlights—keep the line warm across the lake ice.

storyQuests.title: Glacier Shelf Path
storyQuests.speaker: Bram the Tinkerer
storyQuests.dialogue: Mirrorwardens bounced every spitter glob right off the ice shelf!

storyQuests.title: Her Last Warmth
storyQuests.speaker: Warden Mira
storyQuests.dialogue: The northern beacon shines all the way to Kindlekeep's walls.

storyQuests.title: Raise the Standard
storyQuests.speaker: Warden Mira
storyQuests.dialogue: Raise the Keeper's Standard in the Gloomgate pass.

storyQuests.title: The Rekindling
storyQuests.speaker: Warden Mira
storyQuests.dialogue: You gave the kept light freely and sealed the Dimming. Tea's on, Keeper.

storyQuests.title: Master of the Rekindled Roads
storyQuests.speaker: Pip
storyQuests.dialogue: Every single road in Aldenmoor is bright, warm, and safe!

dailyQuests.title: Morning Luster
dailyQuests.desc: Collect 5 drifting sky motes in any battle.

dailyQuests.title: Well-Tended Road
dailyQuests.desc: Place 4 Lumen Wells across any battles.

dailyQuests.title: High Watch Duty
dailyQuests.desc: Place 2 Ember Sentries on elevated Tower Plots.

dailyQuests.title: Keeper's Timing
dailyQuests.desc: Use any Keeper Power (Lantern Flare, Time Lull, or Mote Rain) twice.

dailyQuests.title: Steadfast Gate
dailyQuests.desc: Win any level without spending a Lastlight Ward.

dailyQuests.title: Swift Patrol
dailyQuests.desc: Clear any level under its stated Par Time.

dailyQuests.title: Iron Barricade
dailyQuests.desc: Set 3 Bulwark posts to hold the lanes.

codex.title: I. Aldenmoor & The Old Road
codex.text: Five regions share a single stone highway through the valley of Aldenmoor: Kindlekeep Green, the foggy Murkmarsh, ash-strewn Cinderwood, the frozen basin of Frostmere, and the high pass of the Gloomgate.

codex.title: II. The Great Lantern
codex.text: Raised by the first Wardens at the heart of Kindlekeep, the Great Lantern is a tower of spun crystal and riveted brass. Its core holds a silent, living presence bonded to the Daystar above.

codex.title: III. The Dimming
codex.text: One winter the Daystar began to gutter like a tallow candle in a draft. Where its warmth thinned along the valley rim, the Gloom seeped down the road—hungry for warmth and memory.

codex.title: IV. Order of the Lantern Wardens
codex.text: Keepers, tinkers, and singers who shape captured light into steadfast guardians. A Warden takes no title beyond their work and the quiet promise that the lamps behind them will stay lit.

codex.title: V. Warden Mira's Forty Winters
codex.text: Mira has walked the Green since her braid was dark. She keeps a ledger of repaired way-lanterns, three spare lenses in her satchel, and a kettle always near the coals.

codex.title: VI. Pip's First Spark
codex.text: Every few generations a stray mote slips through the Great Lantern's upper vents and refuses to fade. Pip attached itself to the new Keeper on swearing-in day.

codex.title: VII. Bram's Forge & Workshop
codex.text: Tucked beside Kindlekeep's inner gate, Bram's anvil rings from dusk to dawn. He tempers dark iron in Glimmer-oil and grinds crystal lenses by hand.

codex.title: VIII. Lastlight Wards
codex.text: Five ancient pillars stand before Kindlekeep's gate—one at the head of each lane. If the Gloom reaches a pillar, its stored century of light flares outward, dissolving every shadow in that lane.

codex.title: IX. Nature of the Gloomkin
codex.text: Gloomkin are condensed pockets of cold night shaped by the road they cross. When pierced by sufficient light, their borrowed form unknots and drifts skyward as harmless motes.

codex.title: X. Umbra, Herald of Dusk
codex.text: Old Warden chronicles speak of a courteous voice heard near the Gloomgate pass—a presence that believes light is a tiring burden and darkness is gentle rest.

codex.title: XI. Elevated Tower Plots & Sentries
codex.text: Along the stone rims bordering the highway stand elevated watch-plots. Ember Sentries mounted on these high ledges fire across multiple lanes and clear the sky of flying Duskwings.

codex.title: XII. Winding-Path Crossroads
codex.text: Where ravines, glacier shelves, or cliff switchbacks narrow the valley, the five-lane highway converges into a single winding road flanked by Warden defense plots.

codex.title: XIII. Bogmother of the Channel
codex.text: In the deepest channel of the Murkmarsh, condensed river-mist gathers into the Bogmother. Relighting the six marsh way-lanterns parts her fog for good.

codex.title: XIV. The Cinder Stag's Oath
codex.text: When Cinderwood burned, its antlered guardian absorbed the ash-gloom to spare the saplings. Freed by the Keeper's light, the Stag now watches over the new green shoots.

codex.title: XV. The Rime Matron's Vigil
codex.text: Warden Astrid held the northern Frostmere beacon alone through thirty winters until rime encased her armor. When the Keeper's warmth reached her, she lit the tower one last time.

codex.title: XVI. The Hollow Choir
codex.text: In the aftermath of the Rekindling, resonant echoes of Gloomchanters and Siphons gathered in the old amphitheater until Pip and the Keeper stilled their song.

codex.title: XVII. The Ashen King
codex.text: A monarch of scavenged iron and dual-aspect wards who tested the full breadth of Bram's artillery and bolt guardians along the upper pass.

codex.title: XVIII. The Rekindled Roads & Maw Remnant
codex.text: With the Maw Remnant dissolved and the seam sealed from within, dawn shines unbroken across all six regions of Aldenmoor. The road is open, and the tea is warm.

keeper.almanacIntro: The Keeper is the young Warden who holds Kindlekeep's gate. {KEEPER} stands at the front line and casts light through every battle, moving from lane to lane at your tap. The Keeper can be struck down and rises again after 20 seconds, and the Keeper never wins a battle alone: guardians stay the core of every defense.

bolt.desc: The Keeper casts a free Light Bolt every 2.4s: 12 fixed harm to the nearest enemy within 5 cells. No Lumen cost. The bolt cannot harm flying enemies.
bolt.name: Light Bolt
bolt.positionRule: The Keeper stands at the front line, between the sixth and seventh columns, and moves from lane to lane when you tap a lane. Enemies in the Keeper's lane stop to attack the Keeper; a fallen Keeper rises again after 20 seconds.
bolt.targetRule: Nearest enemy within 5 cells of the Keeper. Ties break toward the enemy closest to the gate, then the earliest arrived. Burrowed and flying enemies are never targeted.

keeper.choiceNote: One Keeper per watch. The choice is kept in the save and can only change by starting a New Watch or deleting the save.

keepers.blurb: A steady young Warden with a gold lantern-light. Speaks little. Holds the gate.
keepers.name: Rowan

keepers.blurb: A bright young Warden with a violet star-light. Quick to laugh. Quicker to hold the line.
keepers.name: Wren

skillTree.fairnessNote: The skill tree never gates story progress. A Keeper with zero skill points can win every level.
skillTree.pointsRule: Skill points: +1 for every 12 stars earned (all levels, best stars count), +1 for every 3 story quests claimed. Daily quests grant no skill points. Most points a watch can ever earn: 27 (21 from 255 stars + 6 from 18 story quests). The full tree costs 33 points, so no Keeper can own every node: choose.
skillTree.respecRule: Respec costs 150 Glimmer and refunds every spent skill point. The Keeper choice never changes on respec.
